notes.content:

notes.title: The Test: Secrets of the Soul now Steamdeck Verified!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

We're just letting everyone know that you can now find The Test Trilogy and other titles on Steamdeck!

If you haven't played all of our titles, you can find them in the bundle below!

Want to be selected as a character in an upcoming game?
We now have opportunities for you to do so in The Fateweaver Series, as well as other titles!

[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

[b]We'd like to thank you all for your continued support, and we ALWAYS read your comments!

We hope you're having an amazing day!

- Randumb Studios[/b]
